name: ASCP
fullName: APIsec University API Security Certified Professional

cost.note: Exam fee. The required APIsec University courses are free.

levelNote: 12-hour hands-on penetration test of two API-driven applications, with a written report. A genuine practical exam, but narrower in scope than the full web credentials above it. Score weights the required training as well as the exam: the APIsec University courses are free and self-paced, a few hours each, so the training carries less weight than a multi-day instructor-led programme. Exam-only score 58, +5 for the training.

name: APIsec Power User
fullName: APIsec University APIsec Power User Certification

cost.note: Exam fee. The required APIsec University courses are free.

levelNote: Raised: a hands-on assessment was sitting below knowledge exams. A practical exercise set; held below the certified tier. A product certification for operating the APIsec.ai scanning platform, not a vendor-neutral API security credential. Scored on that basis.

name: ACP

cost.note: Exam fee. The required APIsec University courses are free.

levelNote: Re-based onto the common knowledge-exam scale. Two hours of multiple choice on API security. 100 multiple-choice questions in 2 hours. Broader syllabus than CASA — five required courses rather than one — but the assessment is the same length and format. The training bonus is capped for a pure multiple-choice exam: a deep course can lift a knowledge exam, but it remains a knowledge exam.

name: CASA
fullName: APIsec University Certified API Security Analyst
prerequisites: OWASP API Security Top 10 and Beyond! course

cost.note: Exam fee. The required APIsec University courses are free.

levelNote: Re-based onto the common knowledge-exam scale. Two hours of multiple choice, associate syllabus. 100 multiple-choice questions in 2 hours behind a single course.
